title: Product Analyst

description: Role: Product Analyst Level: RL2/3 Location: Bangalore Reporting to: Director - Product Management About The Function Ground Transport is one of the fastest growing businesses at MakeMyTrip, serving millions of travellers across Bus, Rail and Cab journeys. The business plays a critical role in expanding travel accessibility across India, particularly in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, while delivering seamless, affordable and reliable mobility experiences. As travel behaviours evolve, Ground Transport is reimagining the booking and travel experience enabled with AI-first product innovation. From personalized recommendations to conversational booking journeys, automated customer assistance and real-time decision systems, we are building the next generation of travel experiences at scale. The Ground Transport team combines deep consumer understanding, data-driven decision making and cutting-edge technology to solve complex traveller problems across the entire journey lifecycle. Product managers, business leaders, engineers, designers and data scientists work together to build experiences that delight customers and drive meaningful business outcomes. About The Role We are looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to join the Ground Transport team. In this role, you will convert product and user journey data into clear insights that help Product Managers validate decisions, measure launches, and shape the roadmap. The Product Analyst will help the business make better product decisions through data, experimentation, and scalable insight systems. This role will own product performance tracking, support discovery and launch analysis, and build AI-enabled workflows and self-serve analytics tools that reduce dependency on manual requests. The analyst will partner with Product, Data, and Technology teams to turn product questions into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable recommendations. What You'll Be Doing Build AI-enabled tooling and self-serve workflows Id entify recurring manual analysis requests and convert them into dashboards, templates, automated reports, or AI-assisted workflows. Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, anomaly detection, workflow documentation, and stakeholder-ready summaries. Partner with data science, product, and technology teams to build a self-serve platform that lets stakeholders answer common product questions independently. Maintain metric definitions, reusable query logic, and documentation so self-serve outputs remain trusted and consistent. Support product discovery and experimentation Partner with Product Managers to frame hypotheses, size opportunities, and evaluate product ideas using data. Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, cohort cuts, and pre/post launch reads to guide roadmap decisions. Create clear readouts that connect analysis to customer impact, business impact, and next actions. Bridge product, data, and technology teams Translate business and product questions into clear analytical requirements, tracking needs, and data definitions. Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve event instrumentation, reporting reliability, and analytical coverage. Create structured product insights for leadership reviews, roadmap discussions, and launch retrospectives. Drive product performance visibility Define success metrics for product launches, feature adoption, funnel movement, engagement, conversion, and retention. Build dashboards and insight narratives that help product and leadership teams understand what is working, what is not, and where to focus next. Identify trends, anomalies, and user journey friction from product data, then translate findings into practical recommendations. Qualification & Experience 1-3 years of experience in product analytics, business analytics, data analytics, BI, or a related product-facing role. Strong SQL and Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar visualization tools. Comfort with product metrics, funnels, cohorts, experiments, and translating analysis into clear business recommendations. Exposure to AI tools, workflow automation, no-code or low-code tools, Python, or analytics engineering is a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with Product, Data, Engineering, Growth, and business stakeholders. Key Success Factors For The Role Success in this role means turning product and user data into clear insights that improve roadmap decisions, feature performance, and customer journeys. The Product Analyst should build trusted dashboards, metrics, and AI-enabled self-serve workflows, while collaborating with the Data Science team on analysis, experimentation, and insight generation. Strong partnership with Product, Data, Technology, and Data Science teams will be key to translating business questions into scalable analytics solutions.

description: Position Overview The Product Owner is a key product role within Storyteq's R&D team, responsible for driving product value and contributing to the competitive advantage of our platform in a fast-moving market. Working closely with engineering teams, customers, and internal stakeholders, the Product Owner ensures the delivery of high-quality product outcomes that meet user needs and business objectives. As part of a collaborative and ambitious product organisation, the Product Owner supports roadmap processes, generates product insights, analyses competitors, and contributes to business case development - all while maintaining a clear focus on impact and measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Strategy and Value Delivery Initiative Development : Develop initiatives to improve product value, with a clear understanding of the problem (backed by data and metrics) and desired outcomes, defining measurable goals Roadmap Contribution : Support the Product Director in maintaining a timely and high-quality roadmap process, ensuring initiatives are well-defined and prioritised Outcome-Driven Mindset: Translate product goals into measurable OKRs and success metrics, ensuring teams operate with clarity and focus on customer impact Market Awareness: Research, assess, and report on competitor capabilities to inform prioritisation and identify strategic opportunities 2. Product Management and Delivery Excellence Engineering Partnership: Work closely with engineering teams to deliver high-quality products on time, maintaining alignment on scope, timelines, and dependencies. Act as the the go-to person for clarifying requirements and making decisions during development. Decisionmaking: Participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and make fast, clear decisions to keep development moving Delivery clarity: Writing clear user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritising what gets built and when. Translating business goals and customer needs into actionable work for engineering teams. Quality Assurance: Ensure quality throughout the development and release process, covering scope definition, designs, stakeholder management, and release planning Cross-Team Cohesion: Ensure consistency and alignment between product teams throughout development, managing cross-team requirements from a client perspective Adoption & Usage Insights: Report on the use and adoption of different product areas, providing actionable insights to guide future investment decisions Data-Led Decision Making: Embed product metrics and usage analytics into all product decisions, ensuring clear accountability and evidence-based prioritisation 3. Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration Product Advocacy: Champion the product vision, strategy, and innovation, communicating it clearly and compellingly to relevant stakeholders across the organisation. Communicating the product vision to the team, ensuring everyone understands why they're building what they're building Customer Centricity: Maintain a strong understanding of user needs and customer feedback, ensuring product decisions are grounded in real-world use cases Internal Collaboration: Work closely with teams across R&D, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure alignment and shared understanding of product direction Clear Communication: Lead meetings with clarity and purpose, ensuring communication is action-focused and drives progress 4. Research and Continuous Improvement Competitive Research: Continuously assess and monitor the competitive landscape, identifying gaps and opportunities to strengthen Storyteq's market position Product Analytics: Analyse and report on product usage and adoption patterns to support informed decision-making and roadmap prioritisation Innovation Mindset: Proactively identify opportunities for product improvement, bringing forward ideas that drive value for customers and the business Documentation & Knowledge: Contribute to product documentation and knowledge assets to ensure clarity, accessibility, and enablement for internal and external stakeholders Requirements Experience and Background 3-4 years of work experience in a Product Management or Product Owner role Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field Proven experience working in or alongside engineering teams to deliver high-quality products Experience in Martech, such as Creative Automation, DAM, or similar platforms, is highly advantageous Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-moving, highly competitive market environment Experience with roadmap processes, product analytics, and stakeholder management Technical Background Strong product thinking with the ability to identify problems, frame solutions, and measure outcomes Confident and assertive communicator - able to lead meetings, align stakeholders, and drive action Structured, analytical, and highly organised - a strong planner and effective multitasker Commercially aware and data-driven in approach to decision-making Fluent in written and spoken English Personal Attributes Enthusiastic and positive with a problem-solving "Can do!" mindset Ownership-oriented with a high sense of responsibility - both internally and towards users Team player: people-smart, eager to learn, and humble Efficient, consistent, and focused on delivering meaningful impact Ready to step into a scale-up environment and thrive on change Benefits 📈 Employee stock ownership. 📅 27 days of annual leave (Well-being Day and Volunteer Day included). 🏡 Hybrid working model (2-3 days from the office). 🚆 Travel allowance. 🚲 A bicycle lease plan with Hellorider after 1 year of employment. 💻 Excellent tools: High-end Laptop, Monitor, and everything in between! 📚 We support your continuous improvement with training, courses, conferences, and books. 🌦 Mental health and wellbeing support: Access to OpenUp. 🥪 Office lunches and endless snacks at the Amsterdam Office. 🍻 The best Friday afternoon drinks. 👵 A Pension contribution for employees who are based in the Netherlands. 🐶 Pet-friendly office, so feel free to bring your furry friend! description: Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung Ende-zu-Ende - von der strategischen Roadmap bis zur Abnahme gelieferter Features. Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklungsteams, Marketing, Sales und dem Management zusammen und bist die treibende Kraft zwischen Markt, Kunde und Technologie. Dabei nutzt du modernste AI Toolings für eine effektive, zukunftsweisende Produktentwicklung. Aufgabenbereich Roadmap-Entwicklung: Verantwortung für eine klare, priorisierte Produkt-Roadmap, abgeleitet aus Markttrends, Kundenfeedback und Unternehmenszielen. Backlog-Management: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung des Backlogs inkl. Priorisierung, Erstellung sprint-fähiger User Stories und PRDs bei Bedarf. End-to-End Delivery: Steuerung des gesamten Prozesses: von der ersten Idee über Discovery und Launch bis zur KPI-Messung. Standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Teams in Berlin und Karlsruhe sowie Stakeholdern aus Marketing, Sales und Management. Prototyping & AI-Workflow: Täglicher, produktiver Einsatz von AI-Tools für Dokumentation, Analyse und schnelle Iteration sowie mit dem Fokus, Hypothesen erlebbar zu machen, statt sie nur zu beschreiben. Klare Kommunikation: Vermittlung von Visionen und Anforderungen auf allen Ebenen, vom Engineering bis zur Geschäftsführung. Qualifikationen Berufserfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager im digitalen Umfeld (SaaS, Cloud oder B2C/B2B). Methodenkompetenz: Sicherer Umgang mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) sowie Standard-Tools wie Jira und Confluence. Technisches Verständnis: Verständnis für API-Zusammenhänge und Systemarchitekturen; idealerweise tiefes Wissen über Open-Source-Ökosysteme (insbesondere Nextcloud). Fokus auf Impact: Klare Ausrichtung auf messbare Outcomes und Kundennutzen statt auf reine Feature-Lieferung. Entscheidungsstärke & Geschmack: Datengestützte Entscheidungsfindung, ergänzt durch gesundes Urteilsvermögen und ein Gespür für gute Produkte. Mindset: Hohe Lernbereitschaft, offenes Teilen von Wissen, Mut zum Experimentieren (auch bei Rückschlägen) sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung über Rollengrenzen hinweg zu übernehmen. Benefits Hybrides Arbeitsmodell sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit. An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke. Moderne Bürofläche mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung bei der Landsberger Allee Ringbahn. Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte. Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops. Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

As a Product Analyst, you will transform complex product and user data into actionable insights that drive business growth and enhance customer experiences. Working at the intersection of analytics, product management, and business strategy, you will help optimize product performance across digital platforms through data-driven decision-making. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate new features, improve user journeys, and identify opportunities for increased engagement and revenue. This role offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment where innovation, ownership, and continuous learning are highly valued. It is an excellent opportunity for an analytical professional looking to make a measurable impact on product strategy and performance. Accountabilities Analyze product performance and user behavior to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Define, monitor, and optimize key product metrics such as retention, conversion, lifetime value, revenue, and churn. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions to support informed decision-making across Product, Marketing, and Operations teams. Conduct in-depth analyses of customer journeys, feature adoption, promotional initiatives, and overall product performance. Partner with Product Managers to evaluate new releases, product enhancements, and A/B testing initiatives. Identify friction points within the customer journey and recommend data-backed improvements. Collaborate with data teams to ensure the quality, consistency, and availability of analytical data. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders. Support customer segmentation, personalization initiatives, and market research to improve user engagement and business outcomes. Requirements Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or in a similar analytical role within digital products. Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets. Hands-on experience with business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent tools. Solid understanding of product analytics, customer behavior analysis, experimentation, and A/B testing methodologies. Experience with event-based analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools is an advantage. Knowledge of digital product monetization models, customer lifecycle management, or online platform analytics is desirable. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience with Python or statistical analysis tools is considered a plus. description: At JetBrains, we’re building an AI-native platform for software development that connects developer workflows, team-level collaboration, and organizational control into a single coherent system. This platform will serve as the execution and governance layer for AI-driven development, deeply integrated with developer tools but designed to work across teams, products, and environments. This is a long-term strategic investment for JetBrains and a key pillar of our vision for the future of software development. We’re looking for a Growth Manager to own the acquisition, onboarding, and activation journey of JetBrains AI for teams and organizations. In this role, you’ll help users discover JetBrains AI through JetBrains product surfaces, clarify its value in their development workflows, and reach meaningful product usage as quickly as possible. You’ll work on product entry points, trial starts, demo and sandbox experiences, onboarding flows, setup journeys, guided education, and activation experiments that help the right audience become active JetBrains AI users. Key Responsibilities Own the acquisition, onboarding, and activation journey of JetBrains AI for teams and organizations. Define, measure, and improve the path from relevant product entry points to meaningful product usage. Optimize acquisition flows across JetBrains entry points, including IDEs, desktop products, plugins, account flows, contextual prompts, and others. Create and improve self-service paths into JetBrains AI, including trial starts, guided demos, sandbox experiences, interactive walkthroughs, and setup flows. Design and iterate on onboarding, guided product education, first-run experiences, contextual prompts, empty states, and other moments that help users discover value. Identify friction points across entry, signup, setup, onboarding, trial, and first-use flows, and turn them into clear product opportunities. Lead experiments aimed at improving acquisition conversion, onboarding completion, trial-to-active conversion, activation, and early repeated usage. Partner with the Marketing department on acquisition journeys, campaign-to-product continuity, life cycle flows, and the transition from marketing touchpoints to product experience. Partner with monetization specialists on trial experience, upgrade prompts, usage limits, and commercial constraints. Work closely with design, engineering, analytics, research, marketing, monetization, and other product teams to ship measurable improvements to the early user journey. Establish clear growth hypotheses, prioritize experiments, analyze results, and turn learnings into product and business decisions. We’ll be happy to have you on our team if you: Have experience in onboarding, activation, and driving product-led growth in developer tools, SaaS, or AI products. Have worked on improving acquisition-to-activation funnels, product entry points, onboarding flows, trial experiences, or new-user experiences. Understand how to connect marketing touchpoints with product-side acquisition into a coherent user journey. Are comfortable using product analytics, funnels, cohorts, segmentation, and qualitative insights to understand user behavior. Have experience designing, running, and interpreting product experiments. Can translate ambiguous growth problems into focused hypotheses, product changes, and measurable outcomes. Understand how to help users reach value quickly without relying on heavy sales assistance or manual onboarding. Have strong UX judgment and care about reducing friction, clarifying value, and building trust with users. Can collaborate effectively with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, monetization, research, and other product teams. Communicate clearly and can align stakeholders around funnel insights, growth priorities, and experiment results. We’ll Be Especially Thrilled If You Have experience with AI-powered products, developer tools, IDEs, DevOps platforms, or software engineering workflows. Have designed acquisition, onboarding, or activation experiences for complex technical products. Have worked on product-led acquisition from owned product surfaces, such as in-app prompts, contextual entry points, trial starts, demos, sandboxes, and interactive walkthroughs. Understand product-led growth in B2B or prosumer products, especially where individual users can influence wider adoption. Are familiar with behavioral analytics tools, experimentation platforms, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and activation modeling. Have a strong intuition for developer audiences and understand their expectations around control, transparency, low friction, and practical value. Why join JetBrains? Strong base salary. This is a long-term strategic investment for JetBrains and a key pillar of our vision for the future of software development. We’re looking for a Growth Manager to own the acquisition, onboarding, and activation journey of JetBrains AI for teams and organizations. In this role, you’ll help users discover JetBrains AI through JetBrains product surfaces, clarify its value in their development workflows, and reach meaningful product usage as quickly as possible. You’ll work on product entry points, trial starts, demo and sandbox experiences, onboarding flows, setup journeys, guided education, and activation experiments that help the right audience become active JetBrains AI users. Key Responsibilities Own the acquisition, onboarding, and activation journey of JetBrains AI for teams and organizations. Define, measure, and improve the path from relevant product entry points to meaningful product usage. Optimize acquisition flows across JetBrains entry points, including IDEs, desktop products, plugins, account flows, contextual prompts, and others. Create and improve self-service paths into JetBrains AI, including trial starts, guided demos, sandbox experiences, interactive walkthroughs, and setup flows. Design and iterate on onboarding, guided product education, first-run experiences, contextual prompts, empty states, and other moments that help users discover value. Identify friction points across entry, signup, setup, onboarding, trial, and first-use flows, and turn them into clear product opportunities. Lead experiments aimed at improving acquisition conversion, onboarding completion, trial-to-active conversion, activation, and early repeated usage. Partner with the Marketing department on acquisition journeys, campaign-to-product continuity, life cycle flows, and the transition from marketing touchpoints to product experience. Partner with monetization specialists on trial experience, upgrade prompts, usage limits, and commercial constraints. Work closely with design, engineering, analytics, research, marketing, monetization, and other product teams to ship measurable improvements to the early user journey. Establish clear growth hypotheses, prioritize experiments, analyze results, and turn learnings into product and business decisions. We’ll be happy to have you on our team if you: Have experience in onboarding, activation, and driving product-led growth in developer tools, SaaS, or AI products. Have worked on improving acquisition-to-activation funnels, product entry points, onboarding flows, trial experiences, or new-user experiences. Understand how to connect marketing touchpoints with product-side acquisition into a coherent user journey. Are comfortable using product analytics, funnels, cohorts, segmentation, and qualitative insights to understand user behavior. Have experience designing, running, and interpreting product experiments. Can translate ambiguous growth problems into focused hypotheses, product changes, and measurable outcomes. Understand how to help users reach value quickly without relying on heavy sales assistance or manual onboarding. Have strong UX judgment and care about reducing friction, clarifying value, and building trust with users. Can collaborate effectively with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, monetization, research, and other product teams. Communicate clearly and can align stakeholders around funnel insights, growth priorities, and experiment results. We’ll Be Especially Thrilled If You Have experience with AI-powered products, developer tools, IDEs, DevOps platforms, or software engineering workflows. Have designed acquisition, onboarding, or activation experiences for complex technical products. Have worked on product-led acquisition from owned product surfaces, such as in-app prompts, contextual entry points, trial starts, demos, sandboxes, and interactive walkthroughs. Understand product-led growth in B2B or prosumer products, especially where individual users can influence wider adoption. Are familiar with behavioral analytics tools, experimentation platforms, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and activation modeling. Have a strong intuition for developer audiences and understand their expectations around control, transparency, low friction, and practical value. Why join JetBrains? Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience. Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office. Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad. Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love. Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes. Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills. Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays. Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services. Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend. Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings. Some benefits may vary depending on location. x We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. description: Dein Team Wir sind URVI (Urban Vitality), eine junge Supplement-Gummy-Brand mit großen Ambitionen: über 1.000 Fünf-Sterne-Bewertungen, Presse in Vogue, GQ und der Süddeutschen Zeitung, ein wissenschaftlicher Beirat und Made in Germany. Wir entwickeln und vertreiben funktionale Gummies für das urbanen Leben, die so gut schmecken, wie sie wirken. Verkauft wird in Deutschland und den USA, über eigenen Online-Shop, Amazon, Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) und den stationären Einzelhandel (Budni, Edeka). Dein Mandat Das Wachstum der Marke in Deutschland und den USA (perspektivisch Europa), mit klarem Schwerpunkt online. Der stationäre Einzelhandel ist heute noch ein kleinerer, wachsender Teil. Die Rolle ist zugleich eine Founders'-Associate-Position: Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern David und Tilman, mit großem Einblick in Geschäftsinhalte und Verantwortung ab Tag eins. Deine Aufgaben Eigener Online-Shop Demand: Du erstellst Kampagnen und kaufst Media auf Social (Meta, TikTok) und Google (SEA), baust SEO aus und steuerst alles auf ROAS, MER und CAC. Ob in-house oder mit Agentur, die Kanäle laufen über Dich. Conversion: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und Merchandising liegen bei Dir. Du verbesserst den Kaufprozess über laufendes A/B-Testing (Shopify, Landing Pages, Checkout, Angebote). Retention: Du baust Wiederkaufsrate und LTV aus, über Newsletter- und E-Mail-Marketing, Subscriptions und Lifecycle-Flows (z.B. Klaviyo). Retail Commerce Distribution & Konditionen: Du baust Listung und Umsatz im Handel aus, vor allem über die Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) und im wachsenden stationären Handel (Drogerien, Supermärkte wie Budni, Edeka), und führst die Konditions- und Promo-Planung. Sichtbarkeit & Content: Du optimierst Content und PDPs auf den Plattformen und fährst die Retail-Media/Ads für Ranking und Abverkauf. Kanalübergreifend Steuerung & Reporting: Du steuerst die Marke über die wichtigsten Kennzahlen (Marge, CAC, LTV), allokierst Budget dorthin, wo der Return am höchsten ist, und lieferst das Reporting für Geschäftsführung und Investoren. Go-to-Market: Wir haben 12 Produkte am Markt und bringen in den kommenden Monaten weitere. Du verantwortest die Launches, von neuen Produkten bis zu neuen Märkten, über alle Kanäle. Forecast & Verfügbarkeit: Du stimmst die Forecasts mit Geschäftsführung, Lieferanten und Logistikdienstleistern ab und stellst sicher, dass Ware über alle Kanäle rechtzeitig verfügbar ist, damit uns keine Umsätze durch Out-of-Stocks verloren gehen. Was Du mitbringst Business Savvy: Du denkst in Umsatz, Marge und Unit Economics und weißt, wie Wachstum funktioniert Analytische Substanz: Du zerlegst Probleme sauber, arbeitest sicher mit Zahlen in Excel/Sheets und entscheidest datenbasiert. Umsetzung & Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bringst Themen selbst ins Ziel. Relevante Erfahrung: Einige Jahre in E-Commerce, Growth, Commercial oder Consulting. Background: Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik oder ein vergleichbar quantitatives Profil. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Werte: Curiosity, Hacker Mindset und Positive Mindset & Fun. Womit Du zusätzlich punktest Praktische Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen (SEO, SEA, Meta, TikTok) und/oder Shop-Systemen (Shopify). Erfahrung im Einzelhandel oder mit Handelsplattformen, ideal Versandapotheken (Shop Apotheke, DocMorris) oder Drogerie/LEH (Listung, Konditionen, Promo). Hintergrund im Supplement-, Health- oder FMCG-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit dem US-Markt oder internationalem E-Commerce ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Produkt- oder Markt-Launches. Berührungspunkte zur Logistik/Fulfillment (Forecast, Verfügbarkeit, 3PL). Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Analysen und Reportings mit KI-Tools. Was Dich bei uns erwartet Ownership & Impact: Umsatz- und Wachstumsverantwortung ab Tag 1, direkter Draht zu den Gründern, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Team & Ort: Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, 4 Tage vor Ort plus freitags optional remote, Kaffee, Wasser, Soft-Drinks und Snacks sind inklusive Mobilität: Deutschlandticket. Startdatum: ab 1. Oktober 2026 Dein Weg zu uns Unterlagen-Sichtung, Rückmeldung in wenigen Werktagen. Kennenlern-Call mit der Geschäftsführung (30 Min). Case: ein reales Szenario aus beiden Kanälen (z.B. "So performt unser Shop-Mix aus SEO/SEA/Meta/TikTok, wo drehst Du zuerst" und "So sehen unsere Zahlen bei Shop Apotheke und DocMorris aus, wie baust Du sie aus"). Der Case ist dein Haupt-Screen für die spezifischen Skills. Kennenlernen mit dem Team. Angebot. Alle anders, alle smart Als chancengleicher Arbeitgeber setzen wir uns bei hy für eine diverse, inklusive und gesunde Arbeitsumgebung ein. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Kandidat:innen, unabhängig von Ethnie, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsbürgerschaft, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Liebe Frauen, haltet Euch nicht zurück! Untersuchungen zeigen, dass Frauen die Messlatte höher ansetzen als Männer und sich erst dann auf eine Stelle bewerben, wenn sie für eine bestimmte Position hoch qualifiziert sind. Wenn Du also der Meinung bist, dass Du einige aber nicht unbedingt alle der von uns geforderten Kriterien erfüllst, nehme bitte trotzdem Kontakt mit uns auf. Wir freuen uns sehr darauf, von Dir zu hören und gemeinsam zu prüfen, ob wir zueinander passen.

They prioritize customer-centric innovation, continuous learning and building high-performing teams. Their leadership style combines strategic vision with hands-on mentorship, fostering a culture of experimentation and accountability while maintaining unwavering commitment to delivery excellence and responsible practices. Where is this role based? Dublin, Ireland with a hybrid working arrangement. Flexible working options available. For more information on our flexible working approach, visit Deloitte Works. If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process. What We Offer Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. The opportunity to broaden your network and pique your sales by attending (inter)national events and congresses. 27 paid days off per year. description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, You’ll Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Senior Growth Manager Salary Range: €45K – €75K Offers Equity Offers Bonus At a Glance You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes. Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong. Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day. Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint. Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner. Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step. What You’ll Bring 💡 You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it. You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions. You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day. Bonus Points If You Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2. Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role. Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn. Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way. Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days. Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one. What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟 Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to. Why Almedia? 🎁 Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success. Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin. Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

description: Most product roles describe ideas and wait for engineers to build them. At Qooling, you'll prove them. As our Product Manager, you sit at the centre of the product: you talk to customers, spot the problem worth solving, build a working AI-powered proof-of-concept yourself — often the same week — and put it in front of real users before a single sprint is committed. What survives goes to engineering as a validated, scoped spec. You'll be the product expert in the company and help set the vision and roadmap together with the founders. Because we're a small team, you'll own both product strategy and product delivery — the PM and PO roles combined in one. We work with the Shape Up Methodology, and you'll be the go-to person when it comes to scoping projects. A Day in the Life of a PO Monday, a CS teammate flags that three customers struggle with the same workflow. By Wednesday you've used AI tools to build a clickable proof-of-concept and put it in front of two of them. One reaction kills your first idea — good, that saved a six-week build. The second version lands. You scope it into a Shape Up pitch, walk engineering through exactly what "done" looks like, and get back a build you'll personally accept against the criteria you wrote. Friday afternoon you zoom out: does this change where the roadmap goes next quarter? That conversation happens with the founders, and your POC is the evidence on the table. What You'll Own Shape what we build Own discovery from customer signal to validated concept Build AI-powered proof-of-concepts to validate ideas before development starts Co-own the product vision and roadmap with the founders Make it ship Run the Shape Up cycle and scope functional projects Keep daily development moving and unblocked Accept work against the criteria you defined (functional and basic QC) Make it land Own release communication to the Customer Team Write product updates and coordinate them with Marketing Use AI to write product documentation customers actually use Is this you? You've worked in QA, business-process analysis or implementation consulting and kept thinking "I could decide what we build better than this." You've already built things with AI tools — not just prompted ChatGPT, but shipped a prototype someone actually used. You think in flows and edge cases, and people like working with you because you make decisions clearly and explain them well. Fluent Dutch and English. Why Join Qooling? You're the product person — no PM hierarchy above you, a direct line to the founders The AI-native way of working is the job, not a side project Your POCs visibly become the product, used daily by people in real workplaces Salary: € 75.000 - € 90.000 (Depending on experience and skills) Lots of freedom, lots of responsibility, flexible holiday schedule

description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy. About The Role Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have. We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience. This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market. What you'll do Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks Who you are Required 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences Nice to have Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF) Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts Why this role, why now E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing. Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We look for people with exceptional abilities, who are excited by hard problems and big opportunities. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €124,800 - €187,200. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

description: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Votre Mission Vous souhaitez piloter des offres télécom B2B à fort impact, de leur conception à leur mise sur le marché ? Rejoignez une fonction stratégique au cœur de l’innovation, de la performance business et de l’expérience client. En tant que Telecom Product Manager B2B , vous gérez un portefeuille de produits télécom tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Vous intervenez comme interface entre les équipes commerciales, techniques, marketing et les partenaires concernés afin de garantir des offres compétitives, rentables et alignées sur la stratégie de l’entreprise. Vos Responsabilités Piloter la performance et la rentabilité d’un portefeuille de produits télécom B2B Définir le positionnement, la tarification et les évolutions des offres Identifier les opportunités de développement grâce aux analyses marché, nouvelles technologies, benchmarks et retours terrain Coordonner le lancement de nouveaux produits en collaboration avec les équipes internes Assurer le suivi des ventes, des reportings et de la qualité des produits Contribuer à la stratégie marketing et au support des équipes commerciales Votre profil : Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 Vous justifiez idéalement de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction similaire Vous combinez vision business, sens analytique et orientation résultats Vous êtes à l’aise dans la gestion de projets transverses et la coordination de multiples parties prenantes Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et relationnelles Compétences requises ou à acquérir Compétences-clé : Gestion de portefeuille produits et pricing Analyse financière et pilotage P&L Gestion de projet et coordination transverse Connaissances technico-commerciales dans l’univers télécom Orientation client, autonomie, rigueur et esprit d’équipe Français et anglais indispensables ; luxembourgeois et allemand constituent un atout

description: You bridge the gap between business operations and AI possibility — mapping how work actually flows today, and showing what it could realistically look like tomorrow. This is a role for someone equally at home in a stakeholder workshop, a BPMN diagram, and a cost model. You start every project by understanding the problem deeply — the people, the data, the friction, the systems of record. Then you figure out where AI can genuinely help, where an existing PropTech vendor already does it better, and what it would actually cost and save to get there. You are the person who keeps us from automating a broken process or building something we should have bought. Location: Berlin What you'll do Run structured stakeholder interviews across asset management, property management, leasing, finance/controlling, and ESG to surface the processes where AI could create real value. Document current-state and target-state processes using BPMN, Visio, or comparable notation — at a level of rigour that engineers, vendors, and auditors can all work from. Build the business case for each opportunity: cost-to-serve today, expected savings, implementation cost, payback, and the assumptions behind every number. Apply build-vs-buy discipline as a default mindset. Before greenlighting any internal build, evaluate whether a PropTech or horizontal SaaS vendor already solves the problem better, faster, or cheaper — and document the reasoning either way. Map every initiative to the relevant systems of record (ERP, property management system, CAFM, data warehouse, document management) and clarify where data lives, who owns it, and where integration boundaries sit. Define functional requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria precisely enough that a Solutions Engineer or external vendor can deliver against them without rework. Partner with the AI Solutions Engineer on scoping, hand-off, and post-launch measurement — closing the loop between projected and actual value. Maintain a prioritised opportunity backlog and a clear, defensible point of view on sequencing. What you bring Real estate domain expertise (required) — several years working in or directly with real estate operations. You understand the difference between a service charge reconciliation and an operating expense recovery, what a rent roll actually contains, how leasing pipelines are managed, and how asset and property management interact day to day. You will not spend your first six months learning vocabulary. Process analysis craft — fluency in BPMN, Visio, or equivalent, with a real portfolio of as-is/to-be process work behind you. Business-case rigour — comfortable building cost models and ROI analyses in Excel from first principles, and equally comfortable defending the assumptions. System-of-record literacy — working understanding of how ERP systems, property management systems, and data warehouses fit together, and where the boundaries between them sit. You don't need to be an integration engineer, but you should know what an API contract is, what master data means, and why it matters. AI literacy — practical understanding of where modern LLMs, automation platforms, and agents genuinely add value — and where they don't. You can tell the difference between a use case that needs Copilot Studio, one that needs a vendor, and one that needs nothing at all. Stakeholder skill — credibility with senior operators and finance partners, patience with end users, and the ability to translate fluently between them. Languages — full professional fluency in German and English. Nice to Have A degree in business administration, industrial engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), real estate / Immobilienwirtschaft, finance, or information systems. Equivalent experience is equally welcome. Prior experience evaluating or implementing PropTech tools (ESG, CAFM, lease management, tenant experience, transaction platforms). Exposure to data warehousing concepts and BI tooling (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). Lean Six Sigma or comparable process-improvement training Your perspective Interesting, varied and broad range of tasks in one of the largest real estate companies in Germany and Europe Individual training and coaching for professional and personal development in our Academy and with our in-house business coach Professionally equipped, in-house gym with trainers and courses at the headquarters in Berlin as well as fitness and health offers through the Wellhub platform at all external locations Comprehensive company health management and company pension scheme Support on the way to work through a subsidy for the use of public transport and the option of leasing a bicycle through Eurorad Mobility and flexibility through the use of pool cars and company cars to carry out tasks Flexible working hours and mobile working for an even better work-life balance Exciting virtual range of family-friendly benefits, including vacation programs, leisure and sports activities and consulting services with our partner company Voiio Opportunity to attend Bundesliga matches of FC Union Berlin, our favorite club Discounts in selected hotels worldwide with up to 30% on overnight stays and special conditions on food and drinks Employee discounts for special conditions in the areas of media, fashion, leisure, facilities and much more via a partner company Additional days off on Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve Have we sparked your interest? Interested? Send your CV and a short note on a process you've redesigned where the result actually stuck.
title: AI Business Analyst (m/f/d)

description: About Pocket Toons Pocket Entertainment, the parent company of Pocket FM, is building the future of episodic entertainment. Building on that momentum, Pocket Toons is now venturing into a new category of episodic entertainment powered by AI production. It's one of the most exciting and ambitious bets in the company right now, and we're looking for someone to help grow it from the front. Why this role is different You'll be figuring out how a brand-new, AI-produced content format gets made, tested, and scaled to millions of viewers. Every week you'll be solving problems nobody has solved before: what makes this new format addictive, how AI production can compress cycles from weeks to days, what "product-market fit" even looks like for something this new. If you're the kind of person who gets a genuine thrill from ambiguity, who can't stop poking at new AI tools to see what they can do, and who wants a shot at building something genuinely industry-first from the ground up — this is a once-in-a-career seat. What you'll own AI-first production — Partner daily with product, tech, and AI teams to push the boundaries of what AI can do in content creation — from scripting and visual generation to localization and personalization. Agentic AI experience is a big plus here; you'll be an early user (and shaper) of agentic workflows in production Market strategy — Decode what global audiences want from this brand-new format — pacing, hooks, binge patterns, content preferences — and turn that into a content and growth strategy nobody else has run yet. You will develop understanding of different geographies Team management — Hire, grow, and lead creative and ops teams to drive the business forward Growth & marketing — Design and execute acquisition and retention strategy across the right channels to build a real, loyal audience for your shows Program management — Keep a steady, reliable drumbeat of new episodes going live, on time, in a production pipeline that's still being invented as you run it Data-driven iteration — Dig into performance data constantly, and use it to inform what gets made next, in a tight loop with editorial and creative teams Process pioneering — Every process you build here is likely a first for the industry. Document what works, kill what doesn't, move fast Who you are Bachelor's degree from a Tier-1 institute 2+ years in a startup or similarly fast-paced, ambiguous environment Genuinely curious about AI — you experiment with new tools on your own time, not just at work. Experience with agentic AI workflows is a strong plus. We'd love to see a sample of your work during the process. High ownership, strong process instincts — a natural "task master" who brings order to ambiguity Sharp people skills; you can rally a room and manage stakeholders without breaking stride Comfortable making smart calls with incomplete information, in a category that's being defined in real time Genuinely excited by the idea of building something industry-first, not just running something that already works
title: Growth Manager

description: Bij ComplianceWise bouwen we aan de toekomst van compliance. Met onze Anti Money Laundering (AML) SaaS-oplossingen maken we anti-witwasprocessen eenvoudig, efficiënt en betrouwbaar. Als marktleider zijn we toonaangevend in het vereenvoudigen van compliance. En we staan nog maar aan het begin. We hebben product-market fit, tractie en een kerngezonde organisatie. Met meer dan 600 klanten die inmiddels op ons vertrouwen en een markt die klaar is voor verandering, groeit ComplianceWise snel, en door heel Europa. En daar hebben we jou voor nodig. Dit is het moment om in te stappen. Als organisatie groeien we en het marketing team is in opbouw. Je hebt een essentiële rol in onze groei en draagt bij aan de toekomst van compliance-technologie, en daarbij aan een eerlijkere wereld. In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt. Over de rol Bij ComplianceWise maken we van compliance iets wat accountants daadwerkelijk willen gebruiken en als Growth Marketing Manager ben jij degene die ervoor zorgt dat we structureel pipeline opbouwen en prospects daadwerkelijk converteren naar klanten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het genereren en nurturen van pipeline, van eerste touchpoint tot gesloten deal. Van LinkedIn-campagnes tot webinars, van nurture flows in HubSpot tot partner campagnes: jij bouwt, test, optimaliseert en schaalt, waarmee je directe impact hebt op onze pipeline. Wat je gaat doen Je zet campagnes op en schaalt wat werkt, waardoor we structureel pipeline genereren: LinkedIn, webinars, events, retargeting en partner campagnes Je bouwt en optimaliseert nurturing flows voor prospects die nog niet klaar zijn om te kopen Je analyseert waar leads afhaken in de funnel en verhoogt conversie van lead → demo → deal Je verbetert segmentatie in HubSpot en zorgt dat de juiste boodschap de juiste ICP bereikt Je optimaliseert onze best lopende campagnes en zorgt voor consistente pipeline groei Je ondersteunt sales bij events en beurzen, van campagneplanning tot maximale pipeline impact Over jou Met een uitgesproken growth mindset experimenteer je graag, werk je datagedreven en zoek je steeds naar manieren om marketing slimmer en schaalbaarder te maken. Je kunt bouwen op: 2–6 jaar ervaring in B2B marketing, demand generation of growth marketing Bewezen track record in campagne-executie die pipeline genereert via LinkedIn, webinars, email en events Hands-on ervaring met het bouwen van nurture flows in HubSpot Analytische instelling: je leest funnel data en weet wat je ermee moet Hands-on mentaliteit: je bouwt en optimaliseert liefst zelf en wacht niet op anderen Vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels Over het team We hebben een open en internationale cultuur waarin vertrouwen, samenwerking en humor centraal staan. Ons team heeft een uitgesproken growth mindset: we leren continu, experimenteren en verbeteren elke dag een beetje verder. We dagen de status quo, onszelf en elkaar graag uit, altijd met nieuwsgierigheid en plezier in innovatie. Onze kernwaarden: We make it happen. We succeed as a team. We launch and learn. We embrace honesty. Waarom werken bij ComplianceWise? Een competitief salaris 25 vakantiedagen, plus de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks 2 weken onbetaald verlof op te nemen Hybride werken: tot 2 dagen per week thuiswerken en tot 2 weken per jaar werken vanuit het buitenland Mogelijkheden tot het opnemen van een sabbatical OpenUp-abonnement voor mentale gezondheid Reiskostenvergoeding voor OV-gebruik Een organisatie die jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling serieus neemt Samenwerken met ambitieuze mensen met achtergronden bij o.a. Google, DataSnipper, Deliveroo en ABN Amro Werk aan innovatieve compliance-oplossingen met inzet van AI en machine learning Maak deel uit van een snelgroeiend bedrijf met focus, kennis en middelen Informele werkomgeving met ruimte voor initiatief, droge humor tijdens lunch en internationale collega's uit meer dan 10 landen Meerdere teamuitjes per kwartaal en gezellige tweewekelijkse donderdagborrels (DoMiBo) op kantoor Een kantoor in Amsterdam met uitzicht op het Olympisch Stadion Inclusiviteit & Gelijke Kansen Bij ComplianceWise streven we naar een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom en gewaardeerd voelt. Wij nodigen iedereen uit om te solliciteren. Heb je een beperking en heb je aanpassingen nodig voor je sollicitatie of tijdens het sollicitatieproces? Stuur dan een e-mail naar people@compliance-wise.com met je naam, de functie waarop je solliciteert en je verzoek voor ondersteuning. We denken graag met je mee. Solliciteren? Ben je enthousiast over deze vacature en denk je dat jij bij ons past? Stuur dan een reactie naar Dick Naezer via recruiting@compliance-wise.com. Let op: voor deze functie is het noodzakelijk dat je gerechtigd bent om binnen de EU te werken.
title: Growth Marketing Manager

description: Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? The Mission Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Our Reach proposition — our consumer portals, including Folders.nl and Promobutler.be in the Benelux and Promozilla portals across ~40 countries — connects millions of shoppers with localized retail deals, flyers, and promotions. It is a core traffic and engagement engine for the company. Your mission as Growth Marketing Manager is to own consumer traffic growth across our portals end to end. You will protect and grow our largest market (Benelux), where the bulk of today's traffic sits, while building a repeatable acquisition playbook to scale our newer Promozilla portals from a standing start. You own every lever that moves consumers to our portals — organic/SEO, social, affiliates and partnerships, paid, and lifecycle/retention. We work ~80% asynchronously and judge you on traffic growth, audience retention, and channel efficiency — not hours on Zoom. What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days) We measure outcomes, not tenure. In your first three months: Day 30: You've achieved full campaign continuity with zero disruption to active Benelux flows, and audited traffic sources across the portal network — establishing a clear baseline of what drives volume in each live market and a working relationship with product and development. Day 60: You've identified the highest-yield channel per market and the friction points capping growth (technical, behavioral, or distributional), and shipped your first round of experiments — across organic, paid, social, partnerships, or lifecycle — with early measurable lift. Day 90: Your highest-leverage channels are running predictably in Benelux, and you've drafted and aligned a scalable acquisition playbook to roll out to the nascent Promozilla markets — mapped to the development team's product and UX/UI ETAs for Q3/Q4. The DNA of a Growth Marketer at Publitas Founder-Level Ownership : You treat the portal network like your own business. You don't wait for a roadmap to be handed to you — you read the data, uncover the insight, chase down the tracking gap, and make high-impact calls autonomously. A Continuous Growth Mindset : Consumer behavior and search/distribution algorithms shift fast. You treat traffic as a system to be engineered — constantly testing unconventional loops, optimizing channel mix, and treating every performance drop as a data point to dissect and iterate on. High Autonomy, Low Ego : In a remote-first, async environment, the work speaks for itself. You're motivated by solving hard distribution problems, not by synchronous cheerleading, and you're comfortable being judged on the real health of portal traffic and retention. The Non-Negotiables Multi-Channel Traffic Mastery : A proven track record driving consumer traffic at scale across the full mix — organic/SEO (including programmatic/technical SEO), paid social and search, affiliates and partnerships, and lifecycle/retention. You understand B2C shopper psychology and how audiences hunt for promotions. High-Volume B2C / Platform Background : Experience in app-first consumer marketplaces, coupon/deal platforms, news/media publishers, or large-scale e-commerce/affiliate networks. Programmatic & Multi-Market Scaling : You've scaled traffic across many markets or properties and understand how to standardize a playbook and localize it efficiently — rather than rebuilding from scratch per market. AI-First Execution : We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. A demonstrable track record of using generative AI and automation to scale campaign copy and localization, build programmatic reporting loops, and trigger automated workflows. We are not looking for "AI-curious" — we look for people already using AI to do better work, with tangible impact to show. Flawless Professional English : You collaborate with the global Publitas team in English; your written communication must be exceptional for an async-first team. Dutch — strong plus . What We Offer You to Win Transparent Compensation: A competitive entry-level base salary of €40 000 - €60 000 (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression. True Remote Autonomy: We work 80% asynchronously using Notion and Slack. We don't monitor your screen or count your hours—we trust you to own your delivery targets and manage your day. Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person. Premium Workspace & Gear: A top-tier MacBook, high-end remote work accessories, and co-working allowance if you prefer an office environment. Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your SaaS skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books. Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays. At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.
title: Growth Marketing Manager (SaaS / Remote / EU)

description: Candidates for this position must be located in the Netherlands. This is a hybrid position with two days in our Amsterdam office. About this position Sitly is on a mission to make childcare accessible and convenient for families everywhere. As the Performance Marketing Manager, you'll play a key role in helping us scale our user acquisition engine across Spain, Brazil and Italy. From Google Ads to Meta campaigns, you’ll own and operate our paid acquisition machine driving performance through experimentation, strategic insight, and executional excellence. You'll bring an AI-native mindset to everything you do, from creative testing to budget analysis, using AI tools such as claude code to move faster and see further than traditional approaches allow. This is a hands-on role where you’ll have the autonomy to shape our digital strategy and the support of a collaborative growth team, including content, design, and analytics. About Sitly Sitly is an international childcare platform that helps parents find babysitters and nannies in their area. With millions of registered users across 14 countries, we are on a mission to make childcare more accessible for families around the world. We are a small, ambitious, and fast-moving team based in Amsterdam. Sitly has been profitable from the beginning and has never raised external funding. This allows us to grow with independence and long-term focus, always putting users first. Responsibilities Budget & Performance Management: Own campaign budgets across markets to ensure monthly spend aligns with targets while maintaining CPA and ROAS goals. Channel Optimization: Manage, analyze, and optimize campaigns across paid search and paid social (e.g., Google, Meta, TikTok). Use AI Tools as a daily multiplier: Writing automation scripts to reduce manual reporting overhead, creating tools to accelerate creative iteration, or developing dashboards to gain better campaign insights, and building new workflows. Creative Strategy: Collaborate with our Creative Coordinator to test and iterate on social ad creatives. Provide direction and feedback to improve engagement and conversions. Editing and optimising creatives using tools like CapCut & Canva. A/B Testing & Experimentation: Design and run tests across ad creatives, bidding strategies, and audience segments to continuously improve campaign performance. Work with Website Manager to run A/B tests on paid landing pages. Insights & Reporting: Analyse campaign performance via Google Analytics and our internal reporting dashboards. Translate data into actionable insights and strategy shifts. Market Trends: Stay on top of industry and platform trends, competitor movements, and algorithm changes to identify new growth opportunities. About you Must-haves: 2+ years of experience managing paid search and paid social campaigns. Deep hands-on expertise with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager. Proven ability to manage performance marketing budgets at scale. Strong analytical skills - comfortable in Google Analytics, Excel/Sheets, and campaign dashboards. Experience developing hypotheses and running structured A/B tests. Fluent in English (this is the working language of the company), with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and performance-focused. A demonstrated habit of using AI tools in your performance marketing work, a recurring use that has changed how you work. Nice-to-haves: Experience in marketplace or B2C growth environments. Background working across multiple international markets. Any of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, French, German. Familiarity with TikTok Ads, Pinterest, or other emerging platforms. Experience using tools like Supermetrics, Looker Studio, or internal BI dashboards. Experience with App Campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads) You won't like this job if: You thrive in a highly structured, slow-paced environment where responsibilities are clearly defined and unexpected challenges are minimal You're sceptical of AI tools or prefer to keep workflows the way you're used to You avoid feedback loops and don’t enjoy collaborating closely with creatives or analysts. You’re not interested in digging into data or embracing AI-powered tools in your workflow. You are looking for a more creative marketing role - this role is heavily focused on performance marketing with emphasis on optimising creatives using Canva and CapCut. Overall we have over 700 thousand monthly active parents and sitters on our platform. We pride ourselves on being an independent, profitable tech company that has never had to raise any funding. One part of our small team (45 people) is working from our office in Amsterdam, and the other part remotely around the world. description: Yuki & The Yuki Way Hi there, welcome to Yuki! Your mission is to elevate our product by focusing on the automated processing of invoices and financial data. Our Team ADP is in an exciting transition; while your core focus is making (financial)data flow seamlessly, you will also explore how AI, ML, and OCR turn ‘data ingestion’ into a strategic advantage. Following the Marty Cagan (SVPG) philosophy, you are co-responsible for ensuring our solutions are valuable, usable, feasible, and viable. The triad: Partner with Design on the solution space and with Tech Leads on technical feasibility and scaling. What you get to do Product vision & roadmap: Co-develop a compelling product vision together with product leadership, tailored to entrepreneurs’ on-the-go financial needs, and translate it into a clear, prioritized, data-driven roadmap. Product discovery: Co-drive continuous discovery, by leading user interviews, market analysis, prototype testing, and analyzing usage data (qualitative and quantitative) to validate problems, reduce risk, and ensure features deliver maximum user value. Outcome ownership: Shift focus from "shipping" to "moving metrics." You are accountable for KPIs like North Star Metric growth, churn reduction, and automated processing rates. Lead cross-functional collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact, partnering closely with customers, design, development, go-to-market and business stakeholders to align efforts and ensure high-quality, timely delivery of solutions to meet our users' problems. Proven ability to use data (quantitative and qualitative) to drive decisions, prioritize the backlog, and define success metrics. Experience with several product management tools: e.g. Mixpanel / Pendo, AzureDevOps / Jira, Notion, etc Technical understanding is a big plus; ability to discuss architecture and technical trade-offs with developers (AI/ML experience is a major plus). Understanding of bookkeeping processes and e-invoicing is an added bonus. Fluent in English (written and verbal). Dutch language skills are a significant advantage.
