Here’s what we offer: Personal development: A generous training budget available from day one for specialized certifications, strategy courses, data analytics training etc. to solidify your expertise in SaaS/FinTech Product leadership. Time off and flexibility: 28 vacation days (and the option to buy extra days), plus the possibility of Workation: up to 5 weeks per year of remote work. Well-being & focus: Access to lifestyle coaches, healthy lunches and other initiatives that contribute to your well-being and focus. Plus the ability to lease a bike via Lease-a-bike. Financial security: A competitive base salary with attractive benefits, including full pension coverage. Optimal workplace: The best hardware, including an Apple or Dell laptop, and a Home-office budget to set up your remote workspace. Plenty of opportunities : Enjoy the speed and autonomy of an innovative scale-up, backed by the stability, vast resources, and global career network of the Visma Group. Team & international culture: Participate in team-building days, and other Yuki events that strengthen the close team spirit in a diverse and international environment. description: We build the products that move TBAuctions and its brands forward, and we want data sitting at the heart of how those products are shaped and judged, not bolted on at the end. This is product analytics owned end to end. You'll embed with a product squad, help shape features with data before they're built, and prove their impact after they ship. You'll be our domain expert for product analytics and, just as importantly, someone who shares that expertise and lifts the whole organisation's ability to work with data. You'll run with ambiguous questions on your own and work with everyone from engineers to the C-suite. We’re driven by our commitment to value, transparency, and innovation. Our goal is to deliver exceptional auction experiences to both bidders and sellers, while continuously improving how we work. Our team is collaborative and diverse, but we share key traits: we’re customer-focused, results-oriented, and unafraid to make bold decisions. We're hands-on, proactive, and always looking to make a positive impact. What You Will Do Embed in feature work start to finish. Bring a data point of view to how a feature is shaped, then measure whether it actually worked. Design and run experiments. Build a repeatable testing methodology you can stand behind, including quasi-experimental designs (like interrupted time series) for when a clean A/B test isn't possible. Own funnel and journey analysis. Find and fix conversion bottlenecks, and maintain the event tracking behind them, instrumenting events, not just consuming them. Build the foundations yourself. Help set up the structure for how we track data, and write and own your own analytics pipelines and data models on the lakehouse, you're hands-on, not waiting on someone else to build every input first. Partner with Product Managers on impact. On success metrics, ROI, and reporting you work hand in hand with PMs: you bring the measurement and the methodology, and together you turn it into decisions the business acts on. Measure our internal tools. Find out whether the tools and backoffice we build for internal use are actually used, and whether they work. Build self-serve tooling. Dashboards and tooling that let teams answer their own questions, so good insight doesn't bottleneck on one person. What You Bring Product analytics domain sense above all: you know how and what to build, you bring best practice to the team, and you share what you know. Strong SQL and Python: comfortable in a Databricks and dbt environment. Solid experimentation and statistics: including designs for when a clean A/B test isn't possible. Behavioural and event analytics experience (Segment or equivalent): you instrument events rather than only consuming them. BI that people actually use (Power BI, Databricks Genie / AI-BI). Communication that holds the room with developers and C-level alike, and flexes to the audience without losing the point. A bias for autonomy and automation: you scope and drive your own work, and automate the repetitive parts. If you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. At TBAuctions, we value eagerness to learn and grow more than just ticking all the qualifications. Why this role Real ownership. You'll own product analytics end to end and be the single point of accountability for the analysis, working autonomously on questions that matter. Close to the product. You sit inside the squad and shape features before they're built, not just report on them afterwards. Room to raise the bar. You'll bring best practice to a team that wants it, and build the tooling that lets the whole organization self-serve. What We Offer You Independent and varied role within an entrepreneurial and innovative organization A yearly salary of €85.000 - €90.000 based on experience Good pension scheme Bonus scheme (up to 1 gross monthly salary per year) 25 vacation days Laptop and iPhone Training opportunities Working in a team of professionals, where hard work is well combined with humor

The Product function is responsible for the entire customer journey, from the user experience of our web and mobile applications to ensuring our backend admin portal is continuously evolving and improving. This cross-functional role partners with Product Managers, Customer Success, Customer Experience, Commercial, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership to evaluate product opportunities, assess business impact, monitor performance, identify market trends, and manage strategic technology partner relationships. Through a combination of analytical thinking, commercial awareness, and external market knowledge, the role will help ensure product investment decisions are informed by evidence, aligned with customer needs, and supported by the right technology partnerships. Core Responsibilities Evaluate new product opportunities, feature requests, and strategic initiatives by assessing customer, commercial, operational, and technical impacts to support informed investment decisions. description: What We Do… At Valeo Foods Ireland, the heart of our business is tasty, nutritious Irish food and drinks with brands such as Jacobs, Odlums, Batchelors and many more. We have exceptional experience and expertise in manufacturing, innovation, food science, research and development, nutrition, distribution, sales, operations, marketing, finance and talent management. We are proud of our brands and the roles they play in Irish life. Purpose of the Role… Revenue Growth Managers within the Category Business division are responsible for identifying and executing strategies to sustainably grow revenue and margin through data-driven analysis and cross-functional planning. The Revenue Growth Manager plays a critical role in optimising Valeo’s investment across pricing, pack architecture, promotion and channel mix to deliver long-term profitable growth. This role has full P&L ownership and accountability to Gross Profit level. The Revenue Growth Manager leads and manages the commercial strategy across all customers for assigned brands or channels, with a focus on improving revenue quality. Close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Insights, Commercial Finance and Supply Chain is essential to develop commercially robust plans that align with brand, customer and consumer needs. Strong stakeholder relationship management and influencing are essential elements of the role. What We are Looking For…. Reporting to the Category Director, the Revenue Growth Manager will work cross-functionally to lead the development of strategies that maximise net revenue and margin. This includes pack-price architecture, promotional ROI, mix management, and investment efficiency. The RGM will translate insights into executable plans, ensuring sales teams are equipped to deliver on strategic revenue initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Revenue Growth Management or Net Revenue Management within FMCG and be highly analytical, commercially astute and strategically minded. What You will Do… Lead the creation of a holistic Commercial Revenue Growth Plan that integrates brand, customer and channel strategies in alignment with Valeo’s short and long-term financial goals. Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer investment ROI and build an internal knowledge base of performance drivers. Own the P&L for assigned portfolio, including forecasting, budgeting, investment management and profitability optimisation. Identify and deliver opportunities to enhance revenue and margin through strategic levers: pack, price, promotion and channel. Build and execute pack-price architecture strategies that optimise price ladders and consumer value perception. Evaluate and improve trade promotional effectiveness using post-event analysis and shopper insights. Partner with Marketing on brand innovation and renovation pricing strategy, ensuring alignment with commercial goals. Oversee the development and delivery of the Brand Annual Commercial Plan and maintain a live plan throughout the year. Lead monthly and quarterly commercial performance reviews (forecast vs actual) and recommend interventions as needed. Drive Joint Business Planning processes with Sales to align on pricing, promotions, trade terms, and investment priorities. Collaborate with Demand Planners and Supply Chain to ensure effective forecast accuracy and service levels. Define and recommend customer pricing strategy and RRPs, ensuring cross-functional alignment and execution. Actively manage new product set-ups, delists and forecast transitions to support successful launches and range optimisation. Monitor aged stock, range performance and mix to inform future rationalisation or optimisation decisions. Work closely with Category and Insights teams to shape a 1–3 year revenue strategy aligned to category growth and brand plans. Foster strong cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Insights, Activation, Finance, Procurement, and Supply Chain. What You will Have… Degree-educated with 4+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management or Net Revenue Management in FMCG. Strong commercial acumen and financial literacy with demonstrated ability to drive profit growth through data-driven strategies. Expertise in pack-price strategy, trade investment management and promotional effectiveness. Strong analytical skills with ability to synthesise financial, shopper and consumer data into actionable insights. Excellent influencing and communication skills, able to collaborate across functions and present clear recommendations. Knowledge of Brand Management, Category Management, Trade Marketing and Sales Planning principles. Strategic, organised, and forward-thinking, with the ability to plan and influence 12–18 months ahead. Who You are…? Results-driven and commercially focused with a collaborative working style. Treats colleagues and customers with integrity, honesty and respect. Agile and adaptable, comfortable navigating change and ambiguity. Clear and confident communicator, able to engage stakeholders at all levels. Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Supports team performance and builds positive working relationships across departments. Committed to driving both individual and collective success by identifying growth opportunities for the business.

description: 36-40 uur / Hoger Beroepsonderwijs Amersfoort / € 4800 - € 6200 Snelstart maakt ondernemen makkelijker. Met slimme software helpen we ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants bij hun financiële processen. Onze multidisciplinaire teams bouwen aan moderne SaaS-oplossingen die dagelijks door tienduizenden gebruikers worden gebruikt. Product owners bepalen bij ons de koers van hun domein. Voor één van die domeinen zoeken we een Technical Product Owner: iemand die de verbinding legt tussen business en techniek, en die net zo goed het gesprek voert met een architect als met een stakeholder. Wat ga je doen? Als Technical Product Owner ben je eigenaar van je productdomein, van visie tot oplevering. Je werkt samen met developers, architecten, designers en interne stakeholders aan oplossingen die functioneel en technisch kloppen. Je bepaalt prioriteiten, houdt de samenhang met andere domeinen in het oog en zorgt dat het team weet wat het bouwt en waarom. Je hoeft geen developer te zijn. Wel voel je je thuis in gesprekken over microservices, API-design en cloudarchitectuur, en weet je op het juiste moment de juiste vraag te stellen. Wat ga je doen: Beheren van de backlog en stellen van prioriteiten, zodat voor het team helder is wat er volgt en waarom. Ophalen van wensen bij stakeholders en vertalen daarvan naar heldere requirements en user stories. Optreden als technisch sparringpartner bij complexe vraagstukken, zoals autorisatie, access control en infrastructuurkeuzes. Signaleren van technische risico’s en bespreekbaar maken van architectuur, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid. Afstemmen met andere product owners over raakvlakken en afhankelijkheden tussen domeinen. Delen van je technische kennis met collega product owners en ondersteunen bij de vertaalslag naar development. Volgen van resultaten na oplevering en bijstellen van de koers op basis van wat je ziet. Wat neem jij mee? HBO werk- en denkniveau. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als product owner, bij voorkeur in een software- of SaaS-omgeving. Begrip van softwarearchitectuur, API-design, cloudomgevingen en development workflows. Ervaring met agile werken: sprintplanning, refinement en reviews. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels, schriftelijk en mondeling. Het vermogen om keuzes kritisch te bevragen zonder de samenwerking te belasten. Pré: Affiniteit met de financieel-administratieve softwaremarkt. Ervaring in een organisatie met meerdere samenwerkende teams en domeinen. Een achtergrond in development, testing of architectuur. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Snelstart vinden we het belangrijk dat je naast je werk voldoende vrije tijd hebt. Daarom krijg je 30 vakantiedagen. Naast je salaris keren we elke maand jouw vakantiegeld en een pensioenbijdrage uit. We zorgen goed voor je met een uitgebreid assortiment aan noten, vers fruit, heerlijke koffie en lekkere thee. Je krijgt een laptop, een hyper-ergonomische bureaustoel en een zit-sta bureau. En misschien wel het belangrijkst: je krijgt er een groep betrokken collega’s bij. Even samenvatten om het makkelijk te maken? Een rol met directe invloed op de richting van ons product. Een aantrekkelijk brutosalaris tussen €4800 en €6200 op basis van 40 uur per week. Een goed geregeld pensioen en elke maand je vakantiegeld uitbetaald. 30 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur per week. Aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, groei, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid. Korte lijnen en ruimte om zelf te bepalen hoe je je werk inricht. Over Snelstart Snelstart maakt ondernemen makkelijker. We helpen ondernemers, boekhouders, bestuurders en professionals met slimme software voor hun financiële processen: van boekhouding, facturatie en administratie tot inzicht, rapportages en kassagerelateerde oplossingen. Dat doen we al meer dan 40 jaar, vanuit de oprechte wens om anderen te helpen: klantgericht, veilig en met oplossingen waar je écht wat aan hebt. De wereld om ons heen verandert snel en dat brengt in het besturen van een onderneming, stichting of vereniging de nodige uitdagingen mee: nieuwe technologieën, economische ontwikkelingen en klimaatverandering. Om in die wereld duurzaam te kunnen groeien, is overzicht en inzicht in je eigen situatie van groot belang. Snelstart wil ondernemers, bestuurders en professionals ondersteunen in hun streven naar duurzaamheid, continuïteit en verantwoord ondernemen. We streven ernaar onze generieke producten en diensten steeds te laten voelen als maatwerk. We bieden inzicht en helpen onze klanten op weg naar zelfredzaamheid. Vanuit onze rol als gids en partner adviseren we reactief én proactief. En we adopteren en integreren technologie voor een duurzame toekomst.

description: Category / Growth Manager — D2C One growth loop: bring demand in → shape the assortment → price & promote → time it to the devotional calendar. You own all four. Experience: 4–5 years About AppsForBharat AppsForBharat, a series C-funded faith-tech startup, is backed by India’s best venture capital investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV partners (prev. Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, & BEENEXT. Our highly ambitious and audacious team comprises alumni from prestigious institutions like IITs & IIMs, with extensive experience in scaling high-growth startups. We're dedicated to developing mobile and web apps catering to the devotional and spiritual needs of 100s of millions of users across the globe. Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, launched in November 2020, is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees. It serves as a digital sanctuary for millions of devotees worldwide. Our mission is to enrich individuals' spiritual lives through innovative technology, offering seamless access to sacred pilgrims & rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant community. The overwhelming user love motivates us as we aim to serve 100s of millions more in the coming years. The devotion market is a $44B opportunity in India (growing at 10% CAGR), which is primarily offline and unorganised. Of the $44B, the temples drive GMV of ~$27B in temple offerings, services, and commerce. There are 2M+ temples in India - about 10k of these temples have a strong historical and cultural significance. Tourism to these religious places is a $10B opportunity. The Sri Mandir app is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees and growing 20-25% month-on-month. Learn more about AppsForBharat: Business World Article, Indian Silicon Valley Podcast, YourStory Article Try the Sri Mandir app: Android / iOS Role Overview You own growth and category for Srimandir's own D2C channel end-to-end. It's a full-loop role: you generate the demand , decide the assortment (how deep within a category, how wide across categories), set the price and promotion , and orchestrate all of it against India's devotional calendar , the rhythm that drives this business. You run the store like a P&L and grow it. What you'll own 1 · Category — vertical & horizontal thinking. Build the assortment on two axes: Vertical (go deep): depth and premium ladders within winning categories, drive the NPD pipeline (new SKUs, variants, price tiers). Horizontal (go wide): expand into new categories, cross-sell and basket expansion — decide what to add, what to scale, and what to cut. 2 · Pricing & promotion. Set the pricing and margin architecture per category; design the discounting, offers and bundling that grow volume without eroding margin. 3 · Calendar planning. Build and run the festive / muhurat / seasonal calendar (Sawan, Navratri, Diwali and the rest) as the operating rhythm — plan launches, campaigns, inventory and promotions against each peak, well ahead of time. 4 · Demand generation (Marketing). Own the funnel end-to-end - traffic (performance marketing across Meta / Google), on-site / in-app conversion, and repeat (CRM, notifications, WhatsApp). Partner with performance and creative teams; own the growth number, CAC and ROAS. What success looks like (first 6–12 months) D2C revenue and growth at or above plan; category contribution up. AOV and repeat-purchase rate rising, with healthy CAC / ROAS. Margin held while scaling volume, pricing and promo discipline. Calendar-led launches shipped on time, with demand captured at each festival peak. What you bring 4–6 years in category management, growth, or D2C e-commerce - deally a mix of category ownership and demand generation. Performance-marketing fluency - run or closely partnered on Meta / Google plus CRM / retention. Pricing and P&L comfort; a sharp assortment / NPD instinct (vertical depth + horizontal expansion). Data-driven - strong analytics; makes decisions from funnel and category data. Nice to have D2C consumer-brand / FMCG / e-commerce background; app or store growth experience. Feel for festive, seasonal, calendar-driven categories. Affinity for the spiritual / devotional space and Indian consumer nuance (Hinglish a plus).

description: Job Description: B2C Growth Manager/B2C Growth Associate Company: Tricog Health Location: Bangalore Function: Growth / GTM / Consumer Business Role Type: Full-time Reporting To: Chief Growth Officer About Tricog Health Tricog Health is a digital health and AI-enabled cardiac care company focused on making timely diagnosis, monitoring, and preventive care more accessible and scalable. This role is meant for someone who can take a consumer health product from early market testing to structured launch and growth. The ideal candidate should be a hands-on growth operator who can understand the consumer problem, identify the right target segments, define the right positioning, build the acquisition funnel, run experiments, and convert early traction into repeatable growth. This is not a pure marketing role. It is a business growth role that connects product, consumer behaviour, campaign execution, sales conversion, customer experience, and revenue outcomes. Key Responsibilities 1. B2C GTM Strategy Own the go-to-market strategy for Tricog's consumer healthcare initiatives. Define target segments, positioning, pricing, channels, and launch plans. Develop city-wise and channel-wise GTM strategies with measurable growth goals. Identify, test, and scale high-potential market segments. 2. Consumer Segmentation and ICP Definition Define and refine Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and consumer personas. Segment audiences based on demographics, health needs, behavior, geography, and affordability. Use campaign and customer insights to improve targeting and conversion. 3. Consumer Acquisition and Growth Drive customer acquisition across digital, offline, partnerships, referrals, and community channels. Optimize the customer journey from awareness to retention. Continuously improve acquisition efficiency, conversion, and scalability. 4. Positioning, Messaging and Campaign Planning Develop clear, consumer-friendly positioning and messaging. Collaborate with content, design, product, and clinical teams on campaigns. Ensure all communication is compliant, credible, and customer-centric. 5. Funnel Management and Conversion Ownership Own the end-to-end consumer funnel from lead generation to retention. Track funnel performance, identify drop-offs, and improve conversion rates. Work with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience and nurturing. 6. Inside Sales and Customer Journey Coordination Partner with inside sales teams to improve lead handling and conversion. Define call flows, qualification criteria, and follow-up processes. Identify consumer objections and enhance the overall customer journey. 7. CRM, Data and Growth Analytics Maintain CRM discipline and accurate lead tracking. Monitor campaign performance, customer behavior, and growth metrics. Build dashboards and provide data-driven recommendations for optimization. 8. Cost Optimisation and Unit Economics Track and optimize acquisition costs, campaign ROI, CAC, and conversion metrics. Improve budget allocation and eliminate underperforming channels. Ensure sustainable and commercially viable growth. 9. Partnerships and Channel Development Build partnerships with healthcare providers, corporates, and community networks. Execute pilot programs and evaluate partnership performance. Scale successful partnerships into repeatable growth channels. 10. Launch and Experimentation Plan and execute market launches for consumer offerings. Conduct structured experiments across pricing, messaging, channels, and customer journeys. Document learnings and scale successful initiatives. 11. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with product, marketing, clinical, sales, operations, and leadership teams. Align campaigns, product positioning, and customer experience across functions. Share market feedback and keep stakeholders informed on progress and key decisions. 12. Consumer Insights and Market Feedback Gather and analyze customer feedback, campaign data, and market insights. Identify consumer pain points, conversion barriers, and churn drivers. Experience working with consumer-facing products, healthcare, wellness, digital health, diagnostics, health services, insurance, fintech, edtech, consumer apps, or subscription businesses will be useful. Experience managing digital acquisition campaigns and conversion funnels. Experience working with performance marketing, inside sales, CRM, customer support, and product teams. Experience launching new offerings or scaling early-stage consumer products will be preferred. Experience in a startup or high-growth environment will be an advantage. Required Skills Strong understanding of B2C growth funnels. Ability to define ICPs, consumer segments, and GTM plans. Strong commercial judgement and ability to connect campaigns to business outcomes. Good understanding of performance marketing channels. Strong analytical skills with comfort in dashboards, campaign data, CRM reports, and funnel metrics. Ability to work with cross-functional teams and drive execution without waiting for perfect information. Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, messaging, and conversion psychology. Ability to create campaign briefs, growth plans, launch plans, and experiment roadmaps. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage ambiguity and build structure in early-stage growth initiatives. High ownership, execution discipline, and bias for measurable results. Good to Have Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, preventive health, remote care, wellness, or digital health. Experience with WhatsApp-led consumer journeys. Experience with CRM tools and lead management systems. Experience working with inside sales or calling teams. Experience building referral, community, or partnership-led growth channels. Basic understanding of healthcare compliance and responsible consumer communication. Experience with landing page optimisation, A/B testing, and retention journeys. Understanding of subscription, repeat usage, or service-led consumer businesses. The person will work at the intersection of healthcare, technology, consumer behaviour, and growth. For someone who wants to go beyond campaign execution and build a real B2C growth engine in healthcare, this is a high-ownership role with meaningful business impact.

description: Als Growth Manager vertaal je klant wensen naar meetbare resultaten en stuur je een team van specialisten aan. Je combineert strategische inzichten met praktische uitvoering en zorgt dat innovatieve groeiplannen ook echt worden gerealiseerd. 1 - Wat we zoeken Je bent een ervaren projectleider met sterke commerciële inzichten en affiniteit met growth hacking. Met jouw strategische blik en hands-on aanpak leid je klantprojecten van concept tot resultaat. Je coacht teamleden, optimaliseert processen en zorgt dat elke klant maximale waarde krijgt. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring en een bewezen track record in projectmanagement en klantbeheer binnen digitale marketing. Je hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding (bachelor of master) op zak in de richting van bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, entrepreneurship of een andere opleiding in een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt sterke analytische vaardigheden en kunt data vertalen naar concrete strategieën en actiepunten. Je hebt commercieel inzicht en weet kansen te herkennen en om te zetten in upsell- en cross-sell-mogelijkheden. Je beschikt over leidinggevende kwaliteiten en hebt ervaring met het coachen van collega’s. 2 - Over de rol als Growth Manager Als Growth Manager krijg je de kans om strategieën te ontwikkelen voor toonaangevende bedrijven. Je werkt samen met diverse klanten en hebt directe invloed op hun groei. Ondertussen bouw je aan een team van specialisten én aan de toekomst van Leapforce. Dit kun je verwachten: Je ontwikkelt groeistrategieën op basis van funnelanalyses en vertaalt deze naar uitvoerbare plannen met een focus op ROI en klantwaarde. Je maakt de klantreis inzichtelijk met een RevOps-aanpak en borgt meetbare groei. Je coördineert projecten over meerdere disciplines en bewaakt voortgang, deadlines, budgetten en resultaten. Je onderhoudt klantrelaties en stuurt bij om doelstellingen te behalen. Je coacht collega’s en helpt je team groeien in hun rol. Je werkt samen met het Tech- en CRM-team om klantgerichte oplossingen te ontwikkelen en implementeren. Je signaleert groeikansen bij klanten en activeert salescollega’s voor upsell- en cross-sell. Je stimuleert innovatie door trends te volgen, experimenten te faciliteren en learnings te delen. Je verbetert interne processen en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van een toekomstgerichte organisatie. 3 - Jouw week als growth manager Je combineert strategisch denken met praktische uitvoering. Klantoverleggen, teamcoaching en procesoptimalisatie wisselen elkaar af. Er is ruimte voor verdieping en innovatie, maar ook voor directe impact binnen lopende projecten. 4 - Over Leapforce Wij zijn Leapforce. Dé growth marketing agency van Amsterdam. We helpen bedrijven groeien met HubSpot-implementaties, RevOps-strategieën en datagedreven marketing. Al meer dan 175 klanten vertrouwen op ons: van scale-ups tot gevestigde namen. Ons team van 35 specialisten haalt elke dag het maximale uit marketing, sales en service. Dat leverde ons in 2022, 2023, 2024 en 2025 de FD Gazelle-award op als erkenning voor onze snelle groei. Het geheim? Ons team. Gedreven mensen die gaan voor buitengewone resultaten. Zowel voor klanten als voor zichzelf. Ons kantoor staat in het creatieve hart van het Amstelkwartier in Amsterdam-Oost. Goed bereikbaar met auto, fiets of OV. Hier bouwen we samen aan klantreizen die converteren. We geven elkaar de ruimte om te experimenteren, ideeën te delen en te groeien. Met plezier, respect en ambitie als fundament. 5 - Perks en cultuur bij Leapforce Kom werken in een award winning team en bij een HubSpot Diamond Partner die zich inzet voor jouw werkplezier. Wij geloven dat je het beste presteert als je je goed voelt. Fysiek, mentaal én in je werk. Daarom bieden we onze medewerkers diverse interessante voordelen: Gezonde balans & extra’s: dagelijks een verzorgde lunch, gezonde snacks, een Urban Sports Club-abonnement en toegang tot een persoonlijke coach voor je mentale en fysieke welzijn. Teamuitjes & events: jaarlijkse bedrijfsuitjes zoals wintersport, padeltoernooien en andere unieke activiteiten met collega’s en klanten. Ontwikkeling: coaching, tijd voor cursussen en een opleidingsbudget om te investeren in je professionele groei. Interesse? Klaar om te solliciteren? Laat dan je gegevens achter via deze link: https://form.typeform.com/to/f6v6IuM4

description: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Gestalte die Digitalisierung: Übernimm eine Schlüsselrolle bei der digitalen Transformation unserer Kunden aus dem Versicherungsumfeld, indem ihr im Team die Kerngeschäftsprozesse durch unsere IT-Lösungen optimierst und digitalisierst. Berate strategisch: Du berätst unsere Kunden umfassend in allen Themen der Digitalisierung mit Schwerpunkt auf bAV (z.B. Massenverarbeitung, Beratungstools, digitale Standmitteilungen). Erhebe Anforderungen: Du übernimmst das Anforderungsmanagement für Softwarelösungen wie Firmenkundenportale, Mitarbeiter-Self-Service-Systeme und Beratungstools durch die Formulierung von User Stories und unterstütze den Product Owner beim Backlogmanagement. Sichere Qualität: Das Testmanagement und fachliche Abnahmen werden von dir übernommen, um die Qualität der entwickelten Softwarelösungen zu gewährleisten. Arbeite im Team: Ein klassisches oder agiles cross-funktionales Team ist dein liebstes Umfeld, um gemeinsam hochwertige Produkte zu entwickeln. DEIN PROFIL Fundierte Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur Kauffrau bzw. zum Kaufmann für Versicherungen und Finanzen oder ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle. Versicherung und IT-Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Versicherungswesen, insbesondere im Bereich der bAV-Geschäftsprozesse einer Lebensversicherung und im Umgang mit IT-Systemen und Portalen. Projektmanagement-Skills: Du konntest bereits Erfahrung im klassischen und agilen Projektmanagement sammeln und verfügst idealerweise über Kenntnisse im Projektcontrolling. Neues aufnehmen und anwenden: Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themengebiete ein und verfügt über relevante Methodenkenntnisse im Consulting. Aktives Zuhören und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen: Damit gelingt es dir, unsere Kunden zu überzeugen. KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. description: At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. The Opportunity We believe that behind every great product feature is an incredible story told by data. As a Product Data Analyst II within our Product Data Group, you won’t just be pulling numbers—you’ll be the critical bridge between Product Management, Engineering, and our Data Group. By diving deep into product telemetry and logs, you'll help us decode user behavior and directly shape the future of our products. What You’ll Do Design for Impact: Collaborate closely with Product Engineering to design data instrumentation that captures genuine user behavior, events, and meaningful outcomes. Translate & Transform: Act as the ultimate translator—turning high-level business questions and new feature requests into crisp, technical data requirements. Uncover Insights: Analyze rich product datasets to guide the development of pipelines and new features, working hand-in-hand with Data Engineers and Data Scientists. Define Success: Help define and track the core metrics and KPIs that truly reflect product health and performance. Guard Data Quality: Conduct rigorous data quality analyses to spot gaps before they become issues, and contribute to the design of robust monitoring and alerting systems. What You’ll Bring To The Table Be kind: F5 has human-first approach Solid Experience: 2-4 years shaping data into insights, with a focus on statistical analysis, dashboarding, and data quality/profiling. Technical Chops: Strong proficiency in SQL—you know how to navigate, query, and tame large, complex datasets. Data Storytelling: Strong ability to shape narratives using data, providing visualization and reports that illuminate the import of the data Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with product telemetry and observability (knowing how products "talk" to us). Collaboration: Stellar communication skills. You know how to tell a compelling story with data and collaborate effortlessly across varied teams. Bonus Points (Nice to Have) Experience navigating a software development organization, including familiarity with version control (git), the SDLC, and testing frameworks. Hands-on experience with modern data stack tools like dbt, Databricks, and Tableau. The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. description: Vacature Product Manager Bouw mee aan de toekomst van voorraadbeheer Bij BarTrack geloven we dat voorraadbeheer en bestellen slimmer, eenvoudiger en efficiënter kan. Met onze software helpen we installateurs, technische groothandels en andere organisaties om altijd grip te hebben op hun materiaal. Van het beheren van voorraadlocaties tot het automatisch bestellen van artikelen: BarTrack brengt het hele proces samen in één platform. Ons team groeit snel en daarmee ook onze ambities. Daarom zoeken we een Product Manager die de brug vormt tussen onze klanten, collega's en developers. Iemand die ervoor zorgt dat de juiste functionaliteiten worden ontwikkeld én dat iedereen begrijpt hoe deze optimaal gebruikt kunnen worden. Wat ga je doen? Als Product Manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling van BarTrack. Je bepaalt samen met de directie de productvisie en vertaalt deze naar een heldere roadmap. Je verzamelt wensen vanuit klanten, implementatie, support, sales en marketing en maakt hierin de juiste afwegingen. Je werkt dagelijks samen met ons developmentteam. Je zorgt ervoor dat developers duidelijke requirements ontvangen, bewaakt de voortgang en test nieuwe functionaliteiten voordat deze worden uitgerold. Maar jouw verantwoordelijkheid stopt daar niet. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedere nieuwe functionaliteit succesvol wordt geïntroduceerd binnen de organisatie én bij onze klanten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de documentatie, schrijft release notes en zorgt dat implementatie, support en marketing precies weten wat er verandert. Kortom: jij bent de eigenaar van het product. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en bewaken van de productvisie en roadmap. Vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete verbeteringen. Prioriteren van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Schrijven van functionele requirements en user stories. Aansturen en begeleiden van het developmentteam. Testen en accepteren van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Coördineren van software releases. Verantwoordelijk voor duidelijke productdocumentatie en release notes. Afstemmen met implementatie, support, sales en marketing. Signaleren van verbeterkansen op basis van klantfeedback en data. Continu verbeteren van BarTrack. Wie zoeken wij? Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en houdt ervan om processen slimmer te maken. Je kunt goed schakelen tussen techniek en praktijk en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar begrijpelijke oplossingen. Je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en krijgt energie van samenwerken met verschillende disciplines. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt een wo-opleiding afgerond. Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring in een rol als Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analist of een vergelijkbare functie. Je hebt affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling. Je hebt sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt prioriteiten stellen en beslissingen nemen. Je werkt gestructureerd en denkt procesmatig. Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands. Waarom werken bij BarTrack? Bij BarTrack geloven we dat de beste ideeën ontstaan door samen te werken. We zijn een klein en ambitieus team waarin iedereen elkaar kent, gemakkelijk bij elkaar binnenloopt en samen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het eindresultaat. Beslissingen worden snel genomen en jouw werk heeft direct invloed op onze klanten én op de ontwikkeling van ons product. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om mee te denken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Geen logge organisatie met eindeloze overlegstructuren, maar een omgeving waarin je echt het verschil kunt maken. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen €4.100 en €5.500 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, plus 8% vakantiegeld . 30 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw rol vorm te geven. Een sleutelrol binnen een groeiend softwarebedrijf waar jouw ideeën direct impact hebben. Een klein, betrokken en enthousiast team met korte lijnen. Een moderne laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed uit te voeren. Een fijne werkomgeving waar samenwerken centraal staat. Enthousiast? Lijkt het je leuk om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van BarTrack? Stuur je CV en een kort bericht waarin je vertelt waarom jij enthousiast wordt van deze functie naar joelle.hable@bartrack.com . ﻿We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

description: Why join us? Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of MillerKnoll means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows MillerKnoll to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone. Digital Product Analyst Location: Bangalore – India JOB SUMMARY: The MillerKnoll Technology team is building a customer-centric, digitally enabled business model to reshape the way our family of brands does business. We’re creating frictionless customer experiences through digital solutions across our platforms, and we need a Digital Product Analyst focused on retail supply chain to help us get there. We are seeking a candidate with strong ecommerce experience who excels at gathering and translating business and user needs into actionable product inputs within an Agile environment. In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to define requirements, support feature development, and ensure solutions are well-understood and effectively implemented. You will play a key role in enabling scalable, high-quality digital experiences by driving clarity, supporting delivery, and helping optimize product performance across our ecommerce portfolio. GENERAL PURPOSE As a Digital Product Analyst, you will support the strategy, analysis, and optimization of MillerKnoll Group’s North America eCommerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Design, and Business stakeholders to analyze customer behavior and conversion performance, define KPIs, and define requirement for core eCommerce capabilities such as merchandising, search, promotions, and checkout. This role requires a high degree of ownership and initiative; you are expected to proactively drive work forward, independently gather missing information, and ensure alignment across cross-functional stakeholders. Essential Functions Support planning and evaluation of product initiatives by partnering with Digital Product Managers and stakeholders to define scope, costs, timelines, and budget alignment. Develop and deliver stakeholder training and enablement for new product features and enhancements, including guidance on functionality, content authoring, data requirements, and platform usage. Ensure user acceptance, performance, and post-production testing are completed and documented in accordance with MillerKnoll testing guidelines. Promote a customer-centered approach to product development and decision-making. Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and vendor capabilities to provide insights and recommendations to Digital Product Managers. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and support product features, shared initiatives, compliance considerations, and operational needs. Define and monitor key metrics and conduct lifecycle analysis of digital products, including pre-launch research, post-launch performance monitoring, and ongoing evaluation to drive continuous improvement. Demonstrate ownership by proactively driving work forward, seeking clarity, and following through on open questions and dependencies. Effectively manage stakeholder relationships through proactive follow-up and independent coordination across business, design, and engineering teams. Clearly articulate requirements, context, and open questions in refinement sessions to enable efficient collaboration with engineering teams. Actively manage and maintain backlog items, including monitoring updates, responding to feedback, and ensuring tickets are complete, accurate, and actionable. Perform additional responsibilities as requested to achieve business objectives Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Education/Experience Bachelor's Degree in IT or Business, Statistics or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 3-5 years of experience in product or business analysis, preferably within digital. Skills And Abilities Experience in eCommerce and front-end retail environments, with hands-on exposure to Salesforce, Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and related digital platforms. Proficiency in Jira and Confluence to support requirements management, backlog tracking, and cross-functional collaboration in Agile environments. Strong experience gathering and documenting business requirements, writing user stories, and supporting system and data mapping across integrated platforms. Create and manage Epics, user stories, and detailed requirements in Jira, and support the analysis and documentation of system integrations to ensure seamless functionality across digital platforms. Ability to analyze complex data and translate findings into clear, actionable insights that inform product decisions and performance optimization. Experience defining, measuring, and evaluating product metrics to assess performance and drive continuous improvement. Solid understanding of digital commerce ecosystems, including platform interactions, data flows, and customer experience dependencies. Experience designing and documenting test scenarios to support user acceptance and validation activities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly translate technical concepts into business-relevant insights and recommendations. Demonstrated critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate options and recommend effective solutions. Note : This role requires working a hybrid schedule ( remote work is not available ) with shift timings from 3:30 PM to 12:30 AM IST . Who We Hire? Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. MillerKnoll is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities. MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers_help@millerknoll.com.

description: Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration. , The Product Manager– Data Products supports the execution and success of Ralph Lauren’s enterprise Data Product strategy by providing analytical rigor, insights, and operational support to Data Product Managers. Working closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams, this role helps ensure data products are clearly understood, well-measured, adopted by users, and continuously improved. As Ralph Lauren advances its multi-year digital and AI-driven transformation—spanning predictive buying, demand forecasting, personalization, and omnichannel experiences—the Product Analyst plays a key role in translating business needs and product intent into metrics, insights, and actionable analysis. The role acts as a bridge between business stakeholders, product managers, data engineering, analytics, and governance teams. The Product Analyst is hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing relationships across functions, while operating within the strategic direction set by Product Managers and the Head of Data Products. , Product Analytics & Performance Tracking Support Data Product Managers by defining and maintaining KPIs, success metrics, and performance dashboards for data products. Track adoption, usage, availability, and quality metrics and highlight trends or issues. Conduct analyses to assess whether data products are meeting expected business outcomes. Prepare clear summaries and insights for product reviews, roadmap discussions, and stakeholder updates. Business & Stakeholder Support Work with Product Managers to engage business stakeholders and understand their data and decision-making needs. Help translate business questions into structured analytical requirements. Support stakeholder communications by providing data-backed insights, usage findings, and impact assessments. Build strong working relationships through responsiveness, clarity, and reliability. Value Measurement & Insights Assist Product Managers in tracking value realization metrics such as efficiency gains, decision support, or process improvements. Maintain baseline and post-launch measurements to support benefit tracking. Identify early signals of low adoption, misalignment, or data quality issues and escalate appropriately. Contribute analytical input to prioritization and iteration discussions. Product Lifecycle Support Support the data product lifecycle from discovery through launch and ongoing iteration. Help ensure analytical readiness for launches, including tracking plans and success criteria. Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to validate metric definitions and outputs. Document learnings, insights, and feedback to inform continuous improvement. Data Quality, Governance & Trust Partner with governance and engineering teams to help monitor data quality, consistency, and reliability. Validate that metrics and insights are interpretable and aligned with agreed definitions. Surface risks related to metric interpretation, data gaps, or inconsistencies. Support responsible data usage by improving transparency and understanding of data products. , Required 4–7+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, business analytics, or related roles. Experience working with enterprise data, analytics platforms, or data products. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and communicate insights clearly. Experience collaborating with product managers, business stakeholders, and technical teams. Solid understanding of data engineering, BI, and analytics concepts. Preferred Experience in retail, consumer goods, or digital commerce environments. Familiarity with Agile or product-based delivery models. Comfort working in global, matrixed organizations. Exposure to cloud-based data platforms.

description: Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires! Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty. About The Team And What We’ll Build Together The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty. How You Will Make An Impact Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancements to Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud, owning the business logic and platform rules that drive loyalty program outcomes for enterprise clients. Translate complex business requirements into precise, unambiguous specifications that serve as the authoritative source of truth for automated and AI-assisted development workflows, while ensuring maximize reusability across clients and verticals. Manage the product backlog including dependencies, priority, sequence, strategy, and business objectives. Identify and address challenges that arise during the product development lifecycle, collaborating with team members to find creative solutions and keep development on track. Provide mechanisms for teams and stakeholders to view and track team and product work progress across releases and major product milestones. Share vision and purpose for all product development efforts, gaining interest and buy-in from various audiences, including business and technical roles at multiple levels of the organization. Owns and evolve the business logic governing your domains of expertise, serving as the voice of reason on what the platform should do and why, influencing technical and business decisions alike. What You Need To Be Successful 5+ years working in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role Demonstrated experience driving Agile/Scrum delivery projects involving web-based software, API and batch integrations, and real-time event-driven systems, with comfort operating in or transitioning toward spec-driven and AI-assisted SDLC environments Exceptional ability to reason through complex business logic, identify edge cases, and produce precise written specifications, paired with strong technical foundation and a knack for translating concepts into language business and tech roles can understand Loyalty product, program, or industry experience strongly preferred; familiarity with accounting ledger concepts, real-time decisioning systems, or rules engines is a plus Familiarity with UX research and best practices a plus PMI-PBA/CBAP/CSPO/PSPO certification a plus Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience About Kobie Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special. We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard. Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities. To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance. As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. description: Are you obsessed with turning insights into measurable growth? What if your experiments didn’t just lift conversions but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential? This Isn’t Another Growth Job. It’s the chance to define a new category : The EcoSystem for Human Greatness Augmented with AI, combining behavioral science, technology, and AI. We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Growth profile who can ideate, copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly. Someone who speaks both data and persuasion fluently, and leverages AI tools daily to generate hypotheses, build assets, and accelerate iteration speed. And you deserve it because you are… 🛠️ You're not "a marketer who runs campaigns." You're a builder. You see a funnel and your hands itch to ship a landing page, wire up an automation, and launch the test by Friday. 🤖 You leverage Claude Code daily , not occasionally. It's not a nice-to-have, it's how you do the job of five people alone: building automations, generating and iterating assets, shipping scripts that used to take a dev. ⚡️ You'd rather ship a scrappy v1 today than a perfect plan next quarter. Bias to action is your default setting. 📊 You make decisions with data. You can read a cohort chart, smell a vanity metric, and tell the difference between a result and a coincidence. You've got 2–3 years under your belt, you're hungry, and you want to walk into a startup and crush it . Then this job might be for you! This is a full-time position, carried out remotely or from our beautiful offices in Dubaï. About Paradox French and English fluency is required. What We Do At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable. That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics. We do that by merging : Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals), Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS . OUR BELIEFS We believe self-help is broken. Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change. At Paradox , we believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation. They deserve a system that knows them , one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them. We believe that every human learns differently , and that technology can do more than entertain or save time. It can translate insight into transformation , through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding . Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create. OUR VISION At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow. We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness. Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come. Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity. To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective. We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact. While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us. Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing. And that’s where you come in. YOUR MISSION 🚀 Be the hands-on builder inside the Growth team. You take funnels apart, rebuild them to convert better, and ship the experiments yourself : copy, landing pages, automations, AI-assisted assets. Your Key Responsibilities Build & ship experiments (CRO & A/B Testing) - You design, launch, and analyze A/B tests yourself : headlines, pricing, offers. You don't wait for a report, you dig into the data to find the winner. AI leverage - Leveraging Claude Code and lightweight automation (n8n/Make) isn't optional here, it's core to the role. Every day, you use AI to build prompt pipelines, generate and iterate creatives, ship small tools/scripts, and turn manual grind into background processes, doing the output of a 5-person team on your own. Build funnels & assets (Hands-On) - You map funnels and build them: landing pages in Webflow, automations, tracking setup. You check the flows and make sure the machine works before anything scales. Hunt friction - You proactively look for drop-off points in the user journey. If a page isn't converting, you audit it, propose a fix, and ship the test immediately with the team. Read the data - You live in GA4, Amplitude, Hotjar, Clarity. You find the insight behind the numbers, kill vanity metrics, and make sure learnings compound over time. Contribute to channels & growth loops - Alongside the team, you test new acquisition angles and help optimize growth loops (retention, referral, content → product → content). You bring data-backed briefs to the Content Factory and spot winning angles fast. Tools you’ll master: GA4, Optibase, Wefblow, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, and whatever helps you see what others miss. You’ll own KPIs : LTV / CAC ratio Funnel conversion rates by stage X experiments launched per week Desired Outcomes Conversion Rates 2× better than baseline Growth experimentation runs continuously A Predictable Growth Engine DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF? Experience 2–3 years in Growth, CRO, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally around SaaS, e-commerce, or digital products. Or you're a self-taught operator with the receipts to prove it. You can show us what you've built and shipped : tests, landing pages, automations, audiences. Portfolio > pedigree. A scrappy before/after beats a polished CV. You already use AI daily to create leverage and solve complex issues. Personality Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data. Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief. Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results. Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks. Language French: Native / Bilingual English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English. IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions. WHY JOIN US ❤️ Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow. Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact. In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall , Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten: “I ran a marathon.” “I started my company.” “I found peace with my father.” You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product. Growth & Ambition > 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform Impact & Meaning > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something! We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives. > ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve… Freedom & Well Being 🗽 > 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability > 🗽Flexible working hours > 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want > 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :) HIRING PROCESS 📃 📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey. 💻 A 15-30 minutes video call , to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path. 💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs. 💻 A culture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture. 💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players. 🤗 Welcome aboard! If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages. If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions. Welcome to Paradox. Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and finding sustainable growth opportunities. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, and Marketing departments. Your Responsibilities As our Business & Growth Manager, you will transition our platform management into a proactive growth engine. You will own the execution of specific strategic pillars and manage the operational foundation that keeps our platforms reliable. Drive Platform Initiatives: Contribute to the 12-month growth strategy for Germany and Austria by taking full ownership of specific campaign pillars and growth execution. Proactive Campaign Ideation: Research market trends and competitor moves to propose, plan, and justify 6 to 8 new customer-facing campaigns and marketing initiatives per year. End-to-End Campaign Management: Manage marketing campaigns from conception and audience segmentation to post-campaign analysis, ensuring we continuously iterate based on data. Customer & Product Advocacy: Bridge the gap between commercial objectives and technical requirements. Identify platform bottlenecks and propose new features to our Product and Tech teams to optimize the customer experience. Operational Excellence: Independently manage relationships with key data partners (such as FMH) and execute core operational tasks, including updating partner bank Terms & Conditions (T&Cs) with high attention to detail. Your Profile We value diverse paths and backgrounds. If you have a proven track record of solving complex analytical problems and driving commercial projects, we want to hear from you. Must-Haves Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in Growth Marketing, Business Development, Strategy Consulting, or a fast-paced commercial environment. Financial Curiosity: A genuine interest in financial markets, interest rates, and personal finance products. Problem-Solving & Analytical Mindset: A strong ability to break down complex business challenges, analyse user behaviours, and translate performance metrics into structured, actionable growth recommendations. You enjoy investigating the "why" behind numbers and building logical business cases. Clear Communication: Experience translating complex technical or commercial concepts into structured proposals. Self-Direction: A natural self-starter who enjoys organising their own work and navigating cross-functional team structures to get projects completed. Languages: Business fluency in German and English is required for navigating local compliance and communicating with our international team. Nice-to-Have Experience working within the FinTech or broader financial services ecosystem. Practical experience utilising Generative AI tools (like ChatGPT) and/or agentic setups to automate routine operational tasks, draft communication templates, or speed up market research. Basic knowledge of SQL for independent data exploration. Experience supporting localised marketing or growth strategies in Austria. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidise your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidise with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

description: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. Meet the Team The Marketing & Growth team is one of the largest and most dynamic at Fever, playing a central role in driving visibility, engagement, and business impact across the company. We work closely with nearly every department, combining strategy, creativity, and data to connect millions of people with unforgettable experiences. Join us if you want to drive global impact, master data-driven creativity, and help millions of people discover their next unforgettable experience. The Role As a Growth Analyst , you will independently lead high-impact global projects and strategies to drive Fever's entertainment market expansion across up to 40 countries. By designing end-to-end solutions and managing new business streams, you will collaborate across departments to enhance overall company performance. What You'll Do In this role, you will contribute to one of Fever's key markets, focusing on its growth and development. Being a Growth Analyst at Fever means working independently and managing your own pipeline of projects within a business line where you can showcase the value you bring. Take part in the exponential growth of fever by taking the lead on global projects that will define the future of the entertainment industry Enhance the overall company performance across different business departments which work together in the creation of new plans and events Define and establish new strategies to increase performance using analytical, business and strategic skills Design end-to-end solutions with daily high impact Create, develop and manage new projects like new business streams, workflows, strategies, and specific departments' growth Work with people and projects across different markets, with a special focus on developing new experiences across markets, in a big international atmosphere (up to 40 countries) Who You Are At least 2 years of experience in an analytics & business role. Background in Engineering or Maths/Statistics/Data Analytics/Strategy. Leverage big data and analytics tools to make strategic business decisions. Excellent communication skills and proven team leadership experience. Excited about working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.
